definitions.gloss: second cousin; child of a parent's cousin
definitions.explanation: A relative who shares a great-grandparent: the child of one's parent's cousin. Also called またいとこ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はとこだ。
⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧はとこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I saw my second cousin for the first time in a while at the memorial service.

examples.japanese: はとこ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧だ。
examples.english: A second cousin is the grandchild of one's grandparent's sibling.

notes:
A second cousin: the child of a parent's cousin, sharing a great-grandparent. Also said as ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦いとこ→いとこ：01816_itoko⟧ or written {再従兄弟|はとこ} (and several other kanji forms by sex), though the kana form is most common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いとこ→いとこ：01816_itoko⟧: (first) cousin — the child of a parent's sibling; one generation closer than はとこ
- ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧: relative — the general term for any extended-family relation
